info.title: ClawDog Calculator-Constellation REST API
info.summary: Public REST + MCP surface over the LodgeiT Labs calculator pool. Discover and invoke 20 SBRM-vocabulary deterministic calculators (Australian Fringe Benefits Tax, Depreciation) from any HTTP/JSON-RPC client.
info.description:
Integration target for partner developers consuming the LodgeiT Labs calculator constellation. Each calculator is a statute-bound deterministic reasoner identified by URN (e.g. `urn:sbrm:calculator:fbt:car-operating-cost`); invocation pairs a calculator URN with a domain-prefixed period URN (e.g. `urn:sbrm:period:fbt:fy2026`). The response carries the computed result, the algebraic trace, a manifest of consumed rate-table sources (with `content_hash` provenance), and an advisory block surfacing compliance hints.

See the `clawdog-calculator-api-integration-kit` for partner-facing docs, runnable examples, and client-regeneration commands.

Request body matches the calculator's declared input schema (see `input_schema_ref` from the discovery response). Response carries the computed result, algebraic trace, manifest of consumed rate-table sources, and an advisory block.

AdvisoryBlock.title: AdvisoryBlock
AdvisoryBlock.description: Compliance advisory block. Surfaces a disclaimer, whether a registered tax agent is required, the statutory basis for that requirement, and the jurisdiction.

CalculatorInvocationResponse.title: CalculatorInvocationResponse
CalculatorInvocationResponse.description: Standard wire shape for any calculator invocation response. Carries the computed `taxable_value`, the algebraic `trace`, a `manifest` of consumed rate-table sources (with `content_hash` provenance), and an `advisory` block.

CalculatorListing.title: CalculatorListing
CalculatorListing.description: One entry in the calculator-discovery listing returned by GET /v1/calculators.

assetId.title: Assetid
assetId.description: Caller-supplied stable identifier for the asset row.

assetName.title: Assetname
assetName.description: Free-text asset description. Used by the Prolog Tier-1 classifier (keyword_map/2 + Stopwords.pl) to resolve effective-life category.

taxMethod.title: Taxmethod
taxMethod.description: The depreciation method historically applied on the tax side. Common values: 'dv' (diminishing value), 'pc' (prime cost). Used by the engine to surface a method-flag warning when the accounting-side ideal differs from the tax-side recorded method.

currentBookAccumDep.title: Currentbookaccumdep
currentBookAccumDep.description: Current ledger-side accumulated depreciation balance at the transition date (AUD). The audit compares this against the ideal-method projection to detect material variance.

DepreciationAuditAssetInput.title: DepreciationAuditAssetInput
DepreciationAuditAssetInput.description:
One asset row in a depreciation-audit batch.

Fields are atom-pure carriers of identity; the engine uses `assetName` via its Tier-1 classifier to resolve effective-life category.

transitionDate.title: Transitiondate
transitionDate.description: ISO-8601 date marking the audit anchor. The engine projects accumulated depreciation to this date and compares against current_book_accum_dep.

method.title: Method
method.description: Accounting-side ideal method to project. 'primecost' = straight-line; 'dvmethod' = diminishing value. The engine default is 'primecost' (matches handle_audit fall-through).

assetsToAudit.title: Assetstoaudit
assetsToAudit.description: Batch of asset rows to audit. The engine processes them sequentially; total runtime is dominated by Tier-1 classifier lookups (keyword_map/2).

DepreciationAuditInput.title: DepreciationAuditInput
DepreciationAuditInput.description:
Input for the Depreciation Audit endpoint.

Carries a `transitionDate`, a `method` discriminator, and an `assetsToAudit` batch. `method` is constrained to `primecost` (straight-line) or `dvmethod` (diminishing value); the engine default is `primecost`.

acquisitionDate.title: Acquisitiondate
acquisitionDate.description: ISO date string ; drives deemed-depreciation tier dispatch.

openingDepreciatedValue.title: Openingdepreciatedvalue
openingDepreciatedValue.description: Opening depreciated value at start of FBT year (AUD). Mutually exclusive with acquisition_cost per engine strict-validation.

acquisitionCost.title: Acquisitioncost
acquisitionCost.description: Original acquisition cost (AUD) for the chained-DV walk; chained-DV entry-point. Mutually exclusive with opening_depreciated_value. When supplied with acquisition_date (and without opening_depreciated_value), the engine dispatches to the chained-DV walk predicate (mc08).

daysHeldInFBTYear.title: Daysheldinfbtyear
daysHeldInFBTYear.description: Days the car was held during the FBT year [0..366]. Required for in-FY-acquisition chained-DV cases (acquisition_date within the FBT year) where the engine's default of 365 would over-state the partial-year leg. Multi-FY chains do NOT need this field (their FY2026 leg is always a full year).

FBTCarOperatingCostInput.title: FBTCarOperatingCostInput
FBTCarOperatingCostInput.description:
Input for the FBT Car Operating-Cost method (FBTAA Division 2 ss.10–10A).

Field names are camelCase on the wire. `businessUsePercentage` is on a 0–100 scale. `acquisitionCost` (chained-DV walk) and `openingDepreciatedValue` (legacy single-year primitive) are mutually exclusive — supply exactly one. `daysHeldInFBTYear` is required only for in-FY-acquisition chained-DV cases.

recipientRent.description: Rent paid by recipient to employer (AUD); reduces taxable value.

FBTHousingInput.title: FBTHousingInput
FBTHousingInput.description:
Input for the Non-Remote FBT Housing Fringe Benefit method (FBTAA s.26(1)(c) + s.26(2)(b)).

`indexationFactor` is period-scoped per s.26(2)(b); FY2026 published State rates span 0.988 (TAS) to 1.100 (WA). Out-of-range values reset to 1.0 (the legacy clamp under-indexes WA's 1.100; partners targeting WA-resident employees should supply 1.0 explicitly to bypass).

FBTLafhaInput.title: FBTLafhaInput
FBTLafhaInput.description:
Input for the FBT Living-Away-From-Home Allowance method (FBTAA s.31; always Type 2 per ATO TR 96/9).

`exemptFoodComponent` is the pre-computed scalar; the TD 2025/2 composition lookup is a caller-side concern.

fbtBenchmarkInterestAmount.title: Fbtbenchmarkinterestamount

interestChargedByEmployer.title: Interestchargedbyemployer

originalLoanAmount.title: Originalloanamount

FBTLoanInput.title: FBTLoanInput
FBTLoanInput.description:
Input for the FBT Loan Fringe Benefit method (FBTAA Division 4 ss.16–19; Type 2 only).

`fbtBenchmarkInterestAmount` is the dollar amount (not the rate); the rate is applied upstream by the caller against `originalLoanAmount` if supplied.
